name: onbeat
description: Turn a song into a beat-synced vertical lyric reel with HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Song in, beat-synced lyric reel out.
interface.longDescription: Measure a song's beats (and optionally its sung words), write a HyperFrames scene on that timing, and render a vertical MP4. Starts with a bundled example that needs no keys.
defaultPrompt: Make a beat-synced reel for my song.
Check the sync of my reel.
